ColonyCouncil.NuisanceDef.label: the fire out in the night

texts.li: The {THING} in {A_nameDef}'s room burned out in the night, and {A_pronoun} woke up cold.
{A_nameDef} found the {THING} cold this morning and dressed as fast as {A_pronoun} could.
Nobody had fed the {THING} in {A_nameDef}'s room, and it went out before midnight.
{A_nameDef} raked through the ash in the {THING}, looking for an ember, and found none.
{A_nameDef} slept badly, curled up under the blanket, after the {THING} in the room went out.
[snow] Snow was falling outside, and the {THING} in {A_nameDef}'s room had been out for hours.
[child] {A_nameDef} woke up cold and went to ask why the {THING} had gone out.
The sole of {A_nameDef}'s {THING} is coming away, and it flapped at every step today.
{A_nameDef} tied {A_possessive} {THING} back together with a piece of string.
{A_nameDef} has worn through the heel of {A_possessive} {THING}, and felt every stone on the path.
{A_nameDef} stopped three times today to shake grit out of {A_possessive} worn {THING}.
[rain] Water got into {A_nameDef}'s worn {THING} at the first puddle, and {A_possessive} feet stayed wet all day.
[winter|cold] The cold came straight up through the thin soles of {A_nameDef}'s {THING}.
[child] {A_nameDef} showed everyone the hole in {A_possessive} {THING}, toe first.
